title: ConnectionsHelperConsentParams
description: Params for connections.helperConsent: the person's answer to the connect-time helper ask (ADR-0068). fingerprint is echoed verbatim from the open failure's helperConsentData (open.helperConsent.schema.json) and is the whole identity the answer is keyed by (ADR-0034) — never the hostname, the profile or the route.

fingerprint.description: SHA256 fingerprint of the destination's host key, echoed from the open failure that raised the ask.

host.description: The destination, for the backend's log line only. The write is keyed by fingerprint alone.

granted.description: true records Granted (the helper may be installed and served for this machine); false records Denied (never asked again, never silently upgraded).
